department: Department of Astronomy (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)

deadline.value: Complete the application by January 15 for full consideration.
deadline.quote: To receive full consideration, application materials should be complete in the Astronomy Department by January 15.

gre_general.value: The department neither accepts nor considers the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: The Department does not accept, nor consider, the Physics or General GRE as part of our application process.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not accepted or considered (dropped from 2020).
gre_subject.quote: The Department does not accept, nor consider, the Physics or General GRE as part of our application process.

also.quote: Beginning in 2020, the Department no longer accepts, nor considers, the Physics GRE as part of our application process.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; students are only encouraged to identify an advisor after admission, before starting.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage admitted students to identify an advisor before starting in the fall.

funding.value: The department does not admit PhD students without offering full financial support (tuition, stipend, health insurance); summer funding is not strictly guaranteed.
funding.quote: At the present time, the department does not admit students without offering them full financial support.

also.quote: The Graduate School offers doctoral students a minimum of five years of financial support upon admission

entry_route.value: A single 5-year route: the first two years include the master's, and students with a prior master's cannot skip coursework.
entry_route.quote: The first two years of the program are dedicated to your Masters. | do not allow students to skip over coursework required for both our M.S. and Ph.D. degrees

notes: Dept page says only 'TOEFL scores, for applicants whose native language is not English'; the Graduate School rules apply.
